Agent Name: ResultVerification_Expert
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: Proposed an inappropriate and flawed method to solve the core question by using an ImageNet image-classification model (EfficientNetB0 with decode_predictions) on whole frames to count “bird” labels. This approach cannot detect or count multiple species present simultaneously in a frame, relies on label text containing “bird,” and misuses a single-label classifier for multi-object detection. This methodological error derailed progress and prevented arriving at the correct answer (3).
